run_extract_images_in_uniform_grid: run extract_images_in_uniform_grid to capture RGB and depth images from a Habitat simulator scene on a uniform grid
run_CLI_scene_extraction: run the CLI to extract RGB and depth images from 3D scenes across datasets like MP3D, HM3D, or Replica
build_habitat_configuration: build a Habitat simulator configuration with RGB and depth camera sensors for a given scene path
get_floor_heights: get floor heights in a Habitat scene by sampling navigable points and clustering Y coordinates with DBSCAN
get_dense_navmesh_vertices: get dense navigable vertices across all floors of a Habitat scene by sampling the navmesh at a given resolution
